prompt:
Style: victorian-picture-book. Picture book illustration for The Steamborg Chronicles: The Engineer's Thumb. Full-page colour plate for a double-page spread. Victorian picture-book watercolour with fine pen-and-ink detail, aged parchment paper texture, warm sepia and amber tones, muted earth colours, soft gaslight and deep shadows. Arthur Rackham meets Sidney Paget. Dramatic but quiet. Not cartoon, not anime, not photorealistic. No modern objects.

COMPOSITION: Wide interior scene, eye-level viewpoint, 3:2 landscape orientation. The scene is divided into three visual zones: left foreground (Watson reacting), centre midground (Catticus on the table examining Hatherley's hand), right background (doorway where Lollipop flees). The composition creates a diagonal action line from left to right.

SETTING: Watson's consulting room at 221B Baker Street. Victorian doctor's consulting room with dark mahogany furniture. A large wooden examination table dominates the centre. Warm gaslight from a brass lamp on the table. Deep sepia shadows. Persian carpet underfoot. An apothecary cabinet and anatomical charts visible on the walls. A heavy wooden door with frosted glass stands open on the right side of the room.

FOREGROUND ACTION — LEFT: Dr John Watson half-springs from a dark leather wingback chair. His body is caught mid-motion, one hand thrust outward toward Hatherley. His face shows a mix of professional concern and frustrated alarm — eyes wide, mouth opening as a shout forms on his lips. He wears a dark Victorian three-piece suit with waistcoat, crisp white shirt, and conservative necktie. His silver-grey hair is slicked back. He has a neatly trimmed grey military moustache. On the table in front of Watson are several basic surgical instruments laid out: a pair of brass forceps, a scalpel, and small surgical scissors — arranged as if he was preparing to treat the wound.

FOREGROUND — CENTRE TABLE: Between Watson and Hatherley, on the wooden examination table, an unfolded white handkerchief lies open, prominently stained red with blood. This is the cloth that contained the severed thumb, now empty because Lollipop has stolen the thumb.

MIDGROUND — CENTRE TABLE: Victor Hatherley sits on the opposite side of the table. He is a young man in his late twenties with sandy hair, a tired face, and travel-worn dishevelled clothing. His right hand is extended across the table, wrapped in thick white bandages. The bandage has a small but clear red stain on the thumb-side. Only FOUR fingers are visible — there is NO thumb on his injured hand; the thumb area is wrapped beneath bandage with no protrusion. His expression is exhausted and shocked.

MIDGROUND — ON THE TABLE: Catticus Finch has jumped onto the table and stands on all four paws, leaning his head close to Hatherley's bandaged hand, sniffing it intently. Catticus is a large silver-grey tabby cat with soft charcoal stripes, white muzzle, broad white bib from chin to chest, white socks on all four paws, and olive-green eyes. CRITICAL DETAIL: His nose is NOT pink — it has transformed into polished brass, an activated Steamborg olfactory sensor, visible as a small brass component where his natural pink nose would be. This is the key visual indicator that his systems have activated. He wears his signature small black Victorian top hat between his ears and a small brass-rimmed monocle over his right eye. His blue collar with round silver tag is visible. His body language is focused, analytical, motionless except for the intent sniffing posture.

BACKGROUND — RIGHT DOORWAY: In the doorway at the right side of the room, Lollipop is captured mid-dash, fleeing from the room. She is a warm brown and tan tabby cat, smaller and slimmer than Catticus, with distinct dark striping, cream chin and throat, and large green eyes. In her mouth she carries a severed human thumb — a small flesh-coloured digit held visibly between her jaws. Her signature steampunk modification is clearly visible: a flexible articulated brass scorpion tail that curves behind her as she runs, made of segmented brass sections ending in a polished stinger. She wears a blue collar. Her movement is swift, a blur of calico fur heading out the door.

CHARACTER CANON — Catticus: Large silver-grey tabby with white bib, white socks, olive-green eyes. Normally pink nose now replaced by polished brass steamborg olfactory sensor (activated state). Small black top hat. Brass monocle over right eye. Blue collar with silver tag. Ordinary cat proportions and behaviour — not anthropomorphic, not robotic. At least 90% visible natural fur.

CHARACTER CANON — Lollipop: Warm brown/tan tabby, smaller than Catticus, slim and athletic. Large green eyes. Cream chin and throat. Fine striped forelegs. Tabby M marking on forehead. Blue collar. Articulated brass scorpion tail — segmented, whip-like, with polished stinger. Not anthropomorphic. At least 90% visible natural fur.

CHARACTER CANON — Dr Watson: Stocky build, silver-grey slicked-back hair, neat grey military moustache. Dark Victorian three-piece suit, waistcoat, white shirt, conservative tie. Warm expressive face caught in alarm. Fully human, no steampunk modifications. Surgical instruments on table in front of him.

CHARACTER CANON — Victor Hatherley: Young man, sandy hair, tired face, travel-worn dark clothing. Right hand wrapped in white bandage with red stain. Only four fingers visible, no thumb. Exhausted and shocked expression.

MANDATORY VISUAL REQUIREMENTS: 1. Watson half-rising from chair with alarmed expression. 2. Surgical instruments (forceps, scalpel, scissors) on table in front of Watson. 3. Hatherley's bandaged hand with exactly four fingers and NO thumb. 4. Red stain on the bandage. 5. Catticus ON the table, leaning close to sniff the bandaged hand. 6. Catticus's nose is polished brass (not pink). 7. Catticus wears small black top hat and brass monocle. 8. Open white handkerchief unfolded on table with red blood stain. 9. Lollipop at the doorway with severed thumb in her mouth. 10. Lollipop's brass scorpion tail clearly visible. 11. Consulting room setting with gaslight, mahogany furniture, Persian carpet. 12. Victorian watercolour illustration style. 13. No modern objects or anachronisms.

NEGATIVE PROMPT ELEMENTS: No extra cats or animals. No robotic or machine-like cats — they should look like natural cats with subtle steampunk elements. No missing top hat on Catticus. No missing monocle. No pink nose on Catticus — his nose must be brass. No visible thumb on Hatherley's right hand. No modern objects, plastic, electronics, or synthetic materials. No cartoon style. No anime. No photorealistic rendering. No duplicated hands or limbs. No oversized or bulky machinery. No glowing eyes. No smoke or steam jets from the cats.
